title: %parseUrl — split a URL into parts
purpose: Parse a URL into an object of scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment.
expectedOutput:
{out}
invalid = ~
{.full}
scheme = "https"
host = "example.com"
port = ##8080
path = "/a/b"
fragment = "frag"
{out.full.query}
a = "2"
z = "1"
{.noPort}
scheme = "https"
host = "example.com"
port = ~
path = "/x"
fragment = ""
notes: Query keys are sorted for canonical output. The port is ~ when absent.
